_comment: Temporary RustSec exceptions only. Each entry needs an advisory id, a concrete justification, and a review window of at most 90 days. Expired entries fail the policy gate.

ignored.reason: atomic-polyfill is lockfile-only through disabled geo-types compatibility features for rstar 0.9–0.11 and heapless 0.7; even the workspace all-feature target graph does not activate it. The notice reports maintenance status, not a vulnerability.

paste is a compile-time transitive dependency of the optional fastembed/tokenizers stack; the notice reports maintenance status, not a vulnerability, and no compatible upstream replacement is available here.

heapless 0.8.0 is reached only through rstar's nearest-neighbour iterator, which uses heapless::BinaryHeap push/pop and one into_vec into a std heap; items are distance wrappers over references with no Drop, so the panic-unwind case cannot occur. The advisory's affected functions (Deque, IndexMap, SortedLinkedList, Spsc, HistoryBuf, the pools, and Vec IntoIter drop under a panicking element Drop) are not called. heapless 0.6.1 and 0.7.17 are lockfile-only through rstar 0.8–0.11 compatibility features of geo-types that no target activates. Retire once rstar releases on heapless >= 0.9.4.

chrono is a direct dependency of the kglite engine for date and datetime values; the notice reports maintenance status, not a vulnerability. Replacing it (jiff or time) is a planned migration, not a lockfile change.
chrono-tz is an optional kglite dependency behind the iana-zones feature for named time zones; the notice reports maintenance status, not a vulnerability. It is replaced together with chrono.
